about_the_game:
The tranquility of day, and the tension of night.

During the day, you'll feel a quiet sense of achievement as you tend to your farm. The process of touching the soil and planting seeds calms a restless mind. This is your healing.

But when night falls, uninvited guests appear, seeking your harvest. They are a nuisance that shatters your peace.

You must respond to this problem using the avocados you grew during the day. Slow the enemy's approach with hard avocados, and install attack avocados behind them to systematically thwart their invasion. Protecting my space with cool-headed wisdom. Every night, your farm becomes a testing ground for your plan.

GAMEPLAY

The tranquility of farm management and the intellectual challenge of fending off an invasion. A turn-based defense game where two kinds of fun coexist.

『AboJam』 is a game where the healing time of cultivating your farm intersects with the time for meticulous strategy to protect its fruits.

Plan and Grow (Day): The day turn is all yours. Plan how you will arrange your avocados. The landscape of your farm and the efficiency of your defense at night will change according to your plan.

Respond and Block (Night): When the night turn begins, the gangs move in an organized manner. They are a threat, but not an unpredictable one. It's time for the defense system you designed to operate. Control the enemy's path with obstacles and neutralize intruders with attack towers. Sometimes, you can even intervene directly.
